posts.name: Rutwik Kulkarni
posts.cooked:
I am unable to see the README.md, evaluation_file.sh, hello.txt, script.sh files in /se2001/assignment_x as shown in this video at 20:01 but I can see them in /opt/se2001/assignment_x. Have I done something wrong? Please guide me on this.

1449×139 8.01 KB

Thank you

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Those files wont be present in ~/se2001/assignment_x, you should just run synchro show to see the question from ~/se2001/assignment_x.

posts.name: Rutwik Kulkarni
posts.cooked: Yes I did that. Then how should I write my solution in /se2001/assignment_x? Do I have to create a script.sh file using mkdir?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
mdkir

mkdir is a command to create directories, not files.

Yes you have to create your script yourself using any text editor you want.

posts.name: Aastha Kaushik
posts.cooked: what is NPPE? and do we have something like OPPE that si NPPE?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: NPPE is the earlier name, it is basically mock OPPE for your practice for OPPE. It is not graded.
